subject: Add New Row of Data to datatable

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Add New Row of Data to datatable
parts:
If there is a data frame loaded initially, and it is desired to add a new row of data, can it be done ? I have a button which is referred to in an observe function. When clicked, it adds a new row to the data frame defined at the top of server.R.

displayTable <<- rbind(displayTable, newRow)

How can the rendered data table automatically update ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Add New Row of Data to datatable
parts:
It is certainly doable if you completely redraw the table with the new
data, but on the other hand, it is certainly not efficient. After a
table is rendered, we need a method to update it without re-render
everything. I have been thinking about this. You may file a feature
request to https://github.com/rstudio/DT/issues if you want. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
